prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right one depends on your goals (social vs. TV), budget, level of customization, whether you need synthetic presenters or dynamic personalization, and how hands‑on you want to be. Below are recommended tools by common use case to help you pick quickly.

Best options by use case
- AI presenters / human-like spokespeople: Synthesia, HeyGen (Elai.io is another option)
  - Pros: realistic synthetic hosts, quick script → finished video
  - Good if you want on-screen presenters without filming
- Short social ads (TikTok/Reels/Stories): InVideo, Lumen5, Canva Video, Promo.com
  - Pros: lots of templates, aspect-ratio presets, easy captions and pacing
  - Good for fast creation and platform-optimized outputs
- Text-to-video / repurposing articles: Pictory, Lumen5
  - Pros: extract key points and auto-generate scenes and captions
- Advanced generative editing / creative FX: Runway
  - Pros: generative tools, inpainting, text-to-video elements, high creative control
- Audio-first editing / voice cloning / transcription: Descript
  - Pros: Overdub (AI voice), easy cut/ edit like a doc, great for talking-head ads and podcasts → video
- Scalable, performance-driven ads & personalization: Shakr, VidMob
  - Pros: built for ad variants, analytics integration, creative optimization at scale
  - Good for agencies and performance teams running A/B tests
- Budget / beginner-friendly all-in-one: Canva Video, Clipchamp, Veed.io
  - Pros: free/cheap tiers, easy templates, useful for small teams
- Stock + ad-focused quick creation: Promo.com
  - Pros: stock footage, ad templates, optimized for conversion

How to choose
- Platform and format: vertical short-form, widescreen, story, in-feed ad?
- Output style: live-action, animated, synthetic presenter, product demo?
- Level of automation vs. manual control: do you want one-click generation or fine editing?
- Scale & personalization: single ad vs. hundreds of variants/personalized creatives?
- Budget & team: single freelancer, in-house marketer, or agency/enterprise?
- Languages/voiceovers: do you need multilingual synthetic voices?

Recommendation and next step
- If you want one quick recommendation: for realistic AI presenters use Synthesia (or HeyGen); for fast social ads with templates use InVideo or Canva; for advanced creative / generative editing use Runway.
- Want a tailored pick? Tell me: your budget, the platform (e.g., Facebook, TikTok, YouTube), desired style (live actor / animated / synthetic presenter), and whether you need many personalized variants — I’ll recommend 2–3 specific tools and a short workflow.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
